biotools.summary: Splitpea is a Python package designed to analyze how alternative splicing events disrupt or increase Protein-Protein Interactions (PPIs). It maps data from alternative splicing tools like SUPPA2 and rMATS to predict PPI network rewiring.
biotools.name: Splitpea: PPI Network Rewiring Analysis
